payload.title: Compare retrievers with a free kNN proxy (lexical v1, v2 with stop words, v2+BM25)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Compare retrievers for free with a kNN proxy before any live retrieval spend.

## Scope

Make `unified_knn` take a pluggable core `Retriever`. For dev-100 items against the 300-label pool, compute label-weighted kNN vote accuracy and same-label purity of the top 4 neighbours for lexical v1, v2 with stop words, and v2 + BM25.

## Definition of done

Specs first (fake data); proxy table committed text-free. If v2 with stop words is worse than v1, recommend flipping the stop-word default off. Cost: $0, no Jev requests.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §4.3, §5.2 (staged retrieval comparison), §5.4, §6 step 6.
